intro: We believe that Reiki healing is far beyond conventional therapy – it opens the doors to universal life force energy which is utilized to facilitate profound healing in the body, mind and spirit. Regardless of whether you are on the road to personal change, professional mastery or spiritual growth, our comprehensive 1/2/3 Level Reiki Healing Course can provide a thorough training in this silent but mighty transformational healing art.

With our full three-tiered curriculum, you will explore the basics to the mastery level, integrating traditional Japanese Reiki with contemporary therapy. Learn how to direct healing power using targeted positioning of hands, create sacred healing places, and develop the necessary skills in personal wellbeing and professional healing practice.

Reiki healing is an ancient Japanese therapeutic technique that uses the energy of universal life force to enhance deep healing and recovery. The name Reiki is a combination of two Japanese terms: Rei, which is universal or divine wisdom, and Ki, which is life force energy and flows through all living things. This light but forceful healing energy is administered by directing this universal energy through the hands of the practitioner to the recipient, usually without direct physical contact, through the appropriate hand positions which align with the energy centers of the body.

policies.title: Important Things to Know before Signing Up
items: Becoming a reiki healer completely depends on an individual’s austerity which can take years.
Reiki is not against medical science. It works together to bring a speedy recovery.
During the reiki practices, one should not indulge in sexual activities.
A true healer is never against medical science, but he/she always works together with it.

If any healer tries to make you believe that reiki healing is above medical science, do not believe the person because both practices work together just as your body needs both legs to make a balance.
Reiki and yoga work well together to achieve great health.
A true reiki healer’s energy speaks (honesty, compassion, respect, love).
Our course certificate confirms you have practiced the reiki under the supervision of an experienced teacher.

We suggest all the practitioners to pursue simple and nutritious diet / early sleep and early wake up / physical exercises / not to eat any kind of meat / take drugs or alcohol. Following the guidelines will help you to experience the depth of reiki practices.
